title: Ceramic wheel course
text: The Lumen Workshop ceramic wheel course costs 120 credits. The course has 6 sessions. Booking is made by email.

title: Glazing class
text: The Lumen Workshop glazing class costs 45 credits. Each glazing class lasts 90 minutes. Booking is made by email.

title: Pottery delivery
text: Lumen Workshop pottery delivery costs 12 credits per order. Pottery delivery takes 4 business days. Orders are packed in cardboard boxes.

title: Order collection
text: Lumen Workshop order collection is available on Tuesday. The order collection desk opens at 14:00. Collection requires the order code.

title: Gift voucher
text: The Lumen Workshop gift voucher value is 80 credits. A gift voucher is valid for 9 months. Gift vouchers are sent by email.

title: Private group workshop
text: The Lumen Workshop private group workshop accepts up to 8 people. The private group workshop costs 240 credits. Participants use workshop tools.

title: Studio rental
text: Lumen Workshop studio rental costs 35 credits per hour. A studio rental slot lasts 2 hours. Rental includes access to work tables.

title: Clay pack
text: The Lumen Workshop clay pack weighs 5 kilograms. The clay pack costs 18 credits. Clay packs are collected at the workshop.

title: Pottery repair consultation
text: The Lumen Workshop pottery repair consultation costs 22 credits. A pottery repair consultation lasts 30 minutes. The customer brings the broken pottery.

title: Workshop exhibition
text: The Lumen Workshop exhibition entry costs 7 credits. The workshop exhibition opens on Saturday. Exhibition visitors receive a printed catalogue.
